title: Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.40545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve. Neither mechanism directly exploits that useful memories at neighbouring retrieval steps may substantially overlap. We propose an alternative in which retrieval is a persistent local traversal through an address space. We separate a memory's content from its address. Utility is defined by the information revealed by retrieving the content, while geometry determines only how cheaply that information can be reached. This leads to a cost-regularised indexing objective that preserves information value inside local neighbourhoods while charging for every memory made locally accessible. translated_title: 检索即遍历：面向有状态长上下文智能体的价值索引记忆
translated_abstract: 长上下文模型反复解决密切相关的检索问题。注意力机制或全局检索能够保留大量存储，但每次前向传播都要重新搜索重要内容；循环压缩虽然避免了这种搜索，却只是通过更早地决定保留哪些信息来实现的。这两种机制都没有直接利用相邻检索步骤中有用记忆可能大量重叠这一事实。我们提出了一种替代方案，将检索视为对地址空间的持久局部遍历。我们将记忆的内容与其地址分离：效用由检索内容所揭示的信息来定义，而几何结构仅决定获取该信息的成本。由此得到一个成本正则化的索引目标，它在局部邻域内保留信息价值，同时对每个被纳入局部可访问范围的记忆收取成本。其边际价值形式同时产生吸引与排斥两种压力。因此，互补……
tldr: 该论文提出将检索建模为地址空间中的持久局部遍历，通过将记忆内容与地址分离并采用成本正则化的价值索引目标，利用相邻检索步骤间记忆的重叠性，使长上下文智能体无需在每次前向传播时重新进行全局搜索。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes modeling retrieval as a persistent local traversal through an address space, separating memory content from address under a cost-regularised value-indexed objective that exploits overlap between memories at neighbouring retrieval steps, so stateful long-context agents no longer re-search globally at every forward pass.
